notes: Primary-record queue for testing permitting, emissions, environmental-justice, civil-rights, national-security, and corporate-state-alignment claims without promoting unverified legal conclusions. Initial AP, NAACP, and Earthjustice source-posture receipts are installed; they locate relevant litigation and institutional-response paths but do not complete the primary-record requirements.

items.record_class: Complete turbine inventory, serial numbers, models, placement, installation dates, and operating history
items.activation_effect: Resolves the number of turbines, which units operated, where they were placed, and whether the system functioned as one coordinated stationary source.
items.notes: Record each unit separately and preserve succession when units are moved, replaced, or decommissioned.

items.record_class: March 2026 MDEQ air permit, application, technical support document, and covered-equipment schedule
items.activation_effect: Establishes the precise number and identity of permitted turbines, emissions limits, controls, monitoring obligations, and effective dates.
items.notes: Do not infer permit coverage from public summaries; use the signed permit and incorporated schedules.

items.record_class: MDEQ temporary or portable equipment classification records and correspondence
items.activation_effect: Tests the factual and legal basis for treating coordinated turbine operations as temporary or portable rather than part of a major stationary source.
items.notes: Acquire internal and external correspondence, duration estimates, mobility records, and any aggregation analysis.

items.record_class: EPA applicability determinations, guidance, correspondence, and enforcement posture
items.activation_effect: Determines whether federal major-source, preconstruction, aggregation, or enforcement requirements applied and how EPA interpreted them.
items.notes: Separate formal determinations from draft guidance, litigation positions, and informal technical assistance.

items.record_class: NAACP litigation docket, complaint, declarations, exhibits, preliminary-injunction filings, and orders
items.activation_effect: Preserves the parties' exact allegations, evidence, defenses, requested remedies, and judicial findings without relying on media summaries.
items.notes: Public source pages identify and describe the litigation, but the complete docket, complaint, declarations, exhibits, defense filings, and orders still require acquisition and verification.

items.record_class: Department of Justice filings and supporting authority concerning dismissal, national security, and economic interests
items.activation_effect: Establishes the precise federal argument and whether private data-center interests were framed as national-security or public-interest necessities.
items.notes: AP reports and links the DOJ motion and preserves the stated national-security, economic, energy-independence, and innovation framing. The complete filing, cited declarations, authority, requested disposition, and limiting language remain required before primary verification.

items.record_class: Actual emissions, fuel use, operating hours, control equipment, monitoring, and inspection records
items.activation_effect: Replaces potential-emissions estimates with measured or reconstructable operational emissions and control performance.
items.notes: Preserve raw measurements, calibration records, operating logs, inspection reports, and exceedance notices.

items.record_class: Public notice, hearing, comment, accessibility, timing, and community-participation record
items.activation_effect: Tests whether affected residents received meaningful notice, accessible participation, adequate time, and a review opportunity before or only after operation began.
items.notes: Record dates, locations, election-day conflicts, language access, attendance, submitted comments, and agency responses.

items.record_class: Census, CDC, state-health, and local airshed datasets used for demographic and respiratory-disease comparisons
likely_custodians: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
items.activation_effect: Permits reproducible measurement of community demographics, baseline disease burden, exposure geography, and uncertainty.
items.notes: Preserve dataset versions, tract boundaries, denominators, confidence intervals, and the exact five-mile or alternative exposure methodology.

items.record_class: Title VI, environmental-justice, and civil-rights complaints, referrals, investigations, findings, or closure records
likely_custodians: EPA Office of External Civil Rights Compliance
Department of Justice Civil Rights Division
items.activation_effect: Determines whether formal civil-rights mechanisms were invoked and how agencies assessed disparate impact, treatment, jurisdiction, and remedy.
items.notes: Absence must not be inferred from a failed public search; obtain custodian confirmation or a reproducible no-record response.

items.record_class: xAI and MZX Tech public statements, legal responses, technical explanations, and national-security assertions
items.activation_effect: Preserves the operator's complete position and prevents adverse-party summaries from substituting for the company's own claims and evidence.
items.notes: AP records that SpaceX did not respond to its current request and reports the prior company position that it complies with law and takes environmental responsibilities seriously. Original company objects, filings, timestamps, revisions, and technical evidence remain required.

items.record_class: Comparable-project control set for large private generation and data-center developments
items.activation_effect: Tests whether permitting flexibility, enforcement timing, public participation, and federal intervention differed across similarly scaled projects and differently situated communities.
items.notes: Document inclusion criteria, comparable capacity, existing pollution burden, demographics, permit timing, enforcement posture, and negative results.
